GLA.source_paper: Signal estimation from modified short-time Fourier transform
GLA.rationale: Foundational unaccelerated baseline in phase retrieval.

FGLA.algorithm: AGLA t-recurrence with theoretically optimal momentum alpha=beta=(1-sqrt(1-lambda_+))/(1+sqrt(1-lambda_+)), gamma=1.0
FGLA.parameters: Oracle-adaptive from local transverse eigenvalue lambda_+
FGLA.rationale: Exact theoretical closed-form single-edge optimal fixed momentum.

Published_AGLA.citation: Perraudin, Sigg, Balazs, IEEE WASPAA 2013, Section 3.1.
Published_AGLA.algorithm: AGLA recurrence with literature-recommended fixed parameters
Published_AGLA.rationale: Canonical published default momentum alpha=0.99 from Perraudin et al. 2013.

Published_NAGLA.source_paper: Accelerated Griffin-Lim Algorithm with Nesterov Momentum / Fast Phase Retrieval
Published_NAGLA.citation: Nesterov (1983) momentum schedule applied to GLA projection map; Perraudin et al. (2013).
Published_NAGLA.algorithm: alpha_i = (i + H - 2) / (i + H + 1), t_{i+1} = P_S P_M(t_i + alpha_i (t_i - t_{i-1}))
Published_NAGLA.rationale: Canonical primary literature parameter H=2 yields standard Nesterov momentum schedule.

Online_Full.source_paper: Geometry Determines Acceleration in Phase Retrieval (ICLR 2027)
Online_Full.algorithm: Ritz-adaptive momentum synthesis with safeguard rollback to GLA
Online_Full.rationale: Strictly frozen configuration from Phase 2B / Phase 4 robustness protocol.
